verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any HRIS or payroll integration that carries a signed offer's new-hire data into onboarding without re-entry. What it does show are developer building blocks: an endpoint that returns a candidate's latest offer, webhook subscriptions, and an MCP server whose scope ends at offer approvals. A customer could build a sync from these, but they are not the product's own HRIS/payroll handoff, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
